critical.signal: Active or near-active exploitation in the wild

curation_actions.blocked: Package matched a curation policy condition — download rejected at the gate
curation_actions.approved: Package explicitly approved via waiver or override — download allowed with audit record
curation_actions.passed: Package evaluated with no matching block policy — download allowed

Repo indexed but has active Critical violations unresolved > 30 days

curation.observation: Curation blocked 55 of 278 package requests this week (19.8% block rate). Maven had the highest block rate at 31.5% — xstream v1.4.11.1 and maven-shared-utils v3.2.1 each triggered 14 blocks, suggesting repeated developer attempts to use vulnerable versions. One malicious HuggingFace model (mcpotato/42-eicar-street — a known EICAR test threat) was stopped by the malicious-package policy; investigate which user account triggered this download.

critical_issues.description: CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell): Unsafe JNDI deserialization in log4j-core:2.14.1 enables remote code execution by logging a crafted string. Actively exploited in the wild since Dec 2021.
CVE-2019-17531: Typing issue in apache-log4j-extra within jackson-databind:2.9.10 allows remote code injection. Actively exploited; upgrade to 2.13.x+.
CVE-2020-9546: Typing issue in Apache Hadoop in jackson-databind:2.9.10 enables RCE. Combined with XRAY-89945 and XRAY-95100, jackson-databind:2.9.10 carries 8+ critical CVEs.
CVE-2016-1000027: Unsafe Java deserialization in Spring RemoteInvocationSerializingExporter (spring-web:5.3.31) enables RCE. No fix in 5.x; upgrade to Spring 6+.
CVE-2025-24813: Design problem in Apache Tomcat (tomcat-embed-core:9.0.83) enables RCE via partial PUT requests. PoC public; upgrade to 9.0.99+.
CVE-2024-52316: Authentication bypass in Apache Tomcat (tomcat-embed-core:9.0.83) when using a custom Jakarta Authentication module. Upgrade to 9.0.98+.
CVE-2021-26291: Missing HTTPS enforcement in maven-core:3.0 allows MitM attackers to modify downloaded artifacts and achieve RCE at build time.
CVE-2022-1471: SnakeYAML Constructor deserialization (snakeyaml:1.30) allows RCE when parsing untrusted YAML. Upgrade to 2.0+.
CVE-2021-38297: Buffer overflow in golang/go:1.12.2 Wasm module parsing can lead to sandboxed RCE. Golang 1.12.2 is severely outdated; upgrade to 1.22+ to resolve 11+ critical CVEs.
CVE-2026-27143: Wrong boundary check in golang/go:1.12.2 leads to RCE via loop induction variable overflow. Newly added 2026-05-13; patch urgently.

violations.observation: 1,163 security violations detected — 108 Critical (9.3%) and 1,052 High (90.5%). jackson-databind:2.9.10 accounts for the most unique critical CVEs (8+ issues with active exploits). log4j-core:2.14.1 (Log4Shell) has been open 64 days. liquid-docker-local leads with 36 violation hits — Docker images likely contain outdated base layer dependencies.

license.observation: 10 High-severity license violations detected, all categorized as unidentified licenses. Affected components include pypi://pillow (multiple versions), npm://node:20.11.5, npm://graph:2.9.3, and gav://org.codehaus.plexus:plexus-velocity:1.2 and plexus-utils:3.2.0. Enable the 'Block Unidentified Licenses' curation policy (already configured) and verify SBOM metadata for Pillow packages used in demo-python-app and shield-python-build builds.

benefit.curation_headline: Stopped 55 packages before entering any repository
benefit.xray_headline: Surfaced 1,715 violations across 46 repos — 108 Critical requiring immediate action
benefit.compare_line: Curation stopped 55 at the gate. Xray found 1,163 security violations already inside.

roi_estimate.calculation_basis: 55 blocked packages × industry-avg $5,000 remediation cost if ingested. Includes one malicious model block (mcpotato/42-eicar-street) and two Log4Shell attempts at $50K incident value each.

threat_velocity.trend_summary: Curation block rate held steady across the week: 27 blocks in the first half (May 19–22) and 28 in the second half (May 23–26). Maven remained the most-blocked ecosystem (34 total). The attempted download of the malicious HuggingFace model on May 22 is an anomalous event warranting investigation.

recommendations.title: Upgrade jackson-databind:2.9.10 — 8+ active-exploit Critical CVEs
recommendations.detail: jackson-databind:2.9.10 carries 8 unique Critical CVEs with active exploits including XRAY-89945 (CVE-2019-17531), XRAY-95082 (CVE-2020-9546), XRAY-95100 (CVE-2020-9547), XRAY-95101 (CVE-2020-9548), XRAY-94620 (CVE-2020-8840), XRAY-93354 (CVE-2019-20330), XRAY-89104 (CVE-2019-16943), XRAY-89105 (CVE-2019-16942). Upgrade to 2.17.3+ which resolves all known typing-confusion deserialization issues. Highest-risk repo: liquid-maven-remote-cache.

recommendations.title: Remediate Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) — log4j-core:2.14.1 open 64 days
recommendations.detail: XRAY-191654 (Log4Shell) and XRAY-192126 (CVE-2021-45046 mitigation bypass) in log4j-core:2.14.1 have been open since 2026-03-23 and are actively exploited in the wild. Curation blocked 2 download attempts this week, suggesting active developer use. Upgrade to log4j-core 2.23.1+ immediately. Check builds repo: avinashg@jfrog.com user executed builds referencing this library.

recommendations.title: Upgrade golang/go:1.12.2 — 11+ Critical CVEs, severely EOL
recommendations.detail: golang/go:1.12.2 (released 2019) carries at minimum 11 Critical CVEs discovered this week: XRAY-187759 (CVE-2021-38297, Wasm RCE), XRAY-198036 (CVE-2022-23806, crypto bypass), XRAY-513412 (CVE-2023-24538, JS injection), XRAY-521541 (CVE-2023-29405, linker exec), XRAY-606108 (CVE-2024-24790, IP filter bypass), XRAY-962113 (CVE-2026-27143, bound check RCE — 13 days old). Upgrade to Go 1.23+ across all Docker images and Go build pipelines to eliminate the entire cluster.

recommendations.title: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core:9.0.83 — 6 Critical CVEs including RCE
recommendations.detail: tomcat-embed-core:9.0.83 has 6 critical violations: XRAY-676707 (CVE-2025-24813, partial-PUT RCE), XRAY-654615 (CVE-2024-52316, auth bypass), XRAY-657841 (CVE-2024-50379, race-condition RCE), XRAY-695198 (CVE-2025-31651), XRAY-738050 (CVE-2025-55754), XRAY-944897 (CVE-2025-66614). Upgrade to 9.0.105+ to resolve all. Found in liquid-maven-remote-cache.

recommendations.title: Investigate malicious HuggingFace model download attempt
recommendations.detail: Curation policy Global-block-malicious-policy-c002 blocked a download of mcpotato/42-eicar-street (a known EICAR-format test threat on HuggingFace) on May 22 from liquid-huggingfaceml-remote. The download was triggered by avinashg@jfrog.com. Confirm this was an authorized security test; if not, audit all HuggingFace model access logs and check for lateral movement.

recommendations.title: Upgrade spring-web:5.3.31 — CVE-2016-1000027 (unsafe deserialization, no fix in 5.x)
recommendations.detail: XRAY-125778 (CVE-2016-1000027) affects spring-web:5.3.31 with no patch available in Spring 5.x. Curation blocked 4 attempts to download this artifact. Migrate to Spring 6.1+ which removes the vulnerable RemoteInvocationSerializingExporter. Also affects liquid-pypi-local (shield-python-build and demo-python-app builds).

recommendations.title: Upgrade SnakeYAML:1.30 — CVE-2022-1471 YAML deserialization RCE
recommendations.detail: XRAY-262821 (CVE-2022-1471) in snakeyaml:1.30 enables RCE when deserializing untrusted YAML using the Constructor class. Upgrade to 2.0+ and replace Constructor usage with SafeConstructor. Found in liquid-maven-remote-cache (transitive via Spring Boot).

recommendations.title: Enable curation coverage for Go and Docker ecosystems
recommendations.detail: Go (liquid-go-remote) and Docker (liquid-docker-local) have zero curation events this week yet lead Xray violation counts: liquid-docker-local has 36 violation hits, liquid-go-remote-cache has 15. Extend curation coverage to these repo types by configuring a remote-repo curation policy or enabling the existing Global policies for these package types. This closes the gap where Curation is the last gate.

recommendations.title: Resolve 10 unidentified license violations
recommendations.detail: 10 High-severity license violations flagged by Global-License-Policy001. Affected packages: pypi://pillow:11.0.0 and pillow:10.3.0 (in demo-python-app, shield-python-build, liquid-pypi-local), npm://node:20.11.5, npm://graph:2.9.3, gav://org.codehaus.plexus:plexus-velocity:1.2, plexus-utils:3.2.0. Confirm SPDX metadata via jf xr component-details and update package manifests.

recommendations.title: Investigate repeated xstream:1.4.11.1 and maven-shared-utils:3.2.1 download attempts (14 each)
recommendations.detail: Both xstream:1.4.11.1 (carrying known deserialization CVEs) and maven-shared-utils:3.2.1 (CVE-2022-29599 command injection) were blocked 14 times each this week. This volume suggests a stale build script or Gradle/Maven wrapper pinned to these versions. Run 'jf rt search liquid-maven-remote-cache --name xstream' to verify no cached copies exist, then update build files to xstream 1.4.21+ and maven-shared-utils 3.3.4+.
